content.text: All eight preferred elements appear in § 22; no other audit or inspection right binds us anywhere in the document.

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit/inspection right binding us (§ 23 contains no operative inspection obligation, and no other verification or remote-monitoring right exists). It satisfies the preferred position in full: frequency capped at once in any twelve-month period; thirty days' prior written notice; normal business hours; off-site where practicable; independent auditor bound by confidentiality; Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§ 22.2); and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly. Section 22.3 adds further Customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement). No redline required.
